## Description

Note editor with sections (Chief complaint, Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan) per template; Objective prefilled from verified chart only (nurse vitals) with provenance; quick phrases and previous-note snippets; autosave drafts every few seconds (server-side, encrypted at rest) so refresh/network loss loses nothing. This is the non-AI baseline that AI must never break; in P3 the "Recording declined" banner reuses it without guilt copy.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Drafts autosave and survive refresh, network drop and session timeout (restored after re-auth with patient confirmation).
- [ ] **AC2.** Prefilled content is only from verified chart data and is labelled with its source.
- [ ] **AC3.** Templates can be switched; switching preserves typed content in matching sections and warns about unmapped content.
- [ ] **AC4.** Note editor is fully keyboard operable and readable at 200 % zoom.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
